About CEPT University

[KUN1213]

Purpose and Mission

CEPT University advances excellence in education, research, and practice
to shape creative leaders and transform human environments.

CEPT University advances excellence in education, research, and practice
to shape creative leaders capable of addressing real-world challenges
across products, projects, places, and processes. The University brings
together the disciplines of architecture, planning, technology, design,
and management in an integrated learning ecosystem.

Its studio-centred teaching programs foster critical thinking,
professional judgment, and ethical responsibility, preparing graduates
to engage meaningfully with complex spatial, social, and environmental
contexts. CEPT’s research deepens understanding of human settlements and
spatial systems, while its advisory projects translate knowledge into
practice — contributing to more liveable, inclusive, and sustainable
habitats. Through education, research, and advisory work, CEPT seeks to
enrich the quality of life in India’s cities and towns, while engaging
with global discourses on human environments.

Academic Units

CEPT University comprises six Faculties that together address the full
spectrum of human environments.

The Faculty of Architecture, established in 1962 as the School of
Architecture, focuses on design in the private realm, advancing
architectural thought, practice, and pedagogy. The Faculty of Planning,
founded in 1972 as the School of Planning, addresses planning and policy
in the public realm, engaging with cities, regions, and communities. The
Faculty of Technology, established in 1982 as the School of Building
Science and Technology, concentrates on engineering, construction, and
building systems, integrating technical rigor with real-world
application.

The Faculty of Design, established in 1991 as the School of Interior
Design, engages with products, crafts, systems, and communication as
integral components of the design ecosystem. The Faculty of Management,
founded in 2013, focuses on habitat and project management, preparing
professionals to lead complex, multidisciplinary projects. The CEPT
Foundation Program (CFP), established in 2017, provides a common
first-year foundation, strengthening essential skills, work ethic, and
capacities that underpin studio-based learning across disciplines.

Alongside, CEPT Professional Programs, established in 2022, supports
individual and organizational learning by offering professional
development, continuing education, and up-skilling opportunities for
in-service professionals across all its disciplines. 

Institutional History & Recognition

CEPT University takes its name from the Centre for Environmental
Planning and Technology. The University and its constituent schools were
established by the Ahmedabad Education Society with the support of the
Government of Gujarat and the Government of India. CEPT was incorporated
as a university by the Government of Gujarat in 2005 and recognized by
the University Grants Commission under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act,
1956, in 2007.

The University is also recognized by the Department of Scientific and
Industrial Research (DSIR), Government of India, as a Scientific and
Industrial Research Organization (SIRO), reinforcing its commitment to
rigorous inquiry, applied research, and societal impact. 

CEPT is recognized as a Centre of Excellence by the Government of
Gujarat since 2022. 

Since 2023, CEPT is one of four Centres of Excellence in Urban Planning
and Design recognized by the Government of India.

The CEPT University Acts and Statutes are the official legal repository
for the institution, outlining its governance framework and operational
structure. It primarily features the CEPT University Act and Statutes
from 2005 and 2010, detailing the university’s incorporation by the
Government of Gujarat and its foundational principles. 

Key highlights of the CEPT Acts and Statutes:

- Core Legal Documents: The page provides access to foundational
  documents including the CEPT University Act and Status 2005 and the
  updated 2010 version.
- Regulatory Framework: The site includes information regarding UGC
  recognition and Government of Gujarat (GOG) recognition.
- University Governance: These acts define the powers, functions, and
  duties of the university, enabling it to maintain academic standards
  in habitat-related disciplines.
- Accessibility: The documents outline the formal structure, providing
  transparency regarding the university’s management and compliance with
  Indian educational regulations.

The Ahmedabad Education Society (AES) established the Centre for
Environment Planning & Technology (CEPT) in the year 1962 with the
inception of School of Architecture (SA) through grant-in-aid from the
Government of Gujarat. The School of Planning (SP) was established in
1972 with financial support from the Government of India (MHRD), the
Government of Gujarat and the Ford Foundation. The other schools, School
of Building Science and Technology (SBST) and School of Interior Design
(SID) were established in 1982 and 1991 respectively with grant-in-aid
from the Government of Gujarat.

Establishment

--
affiliated to the Hemachandracharya North Gujarat University at Patan.
Consequently, students completing various programs at CEPT were awarded
bachelor’s and master’s degrees. CEPT became a University by the Gujarat
State Legislature Act of 2005 with effect from April 12, 2005. CEPT
University has been recognized by the University Grants Commission under
Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956 in February 2007. The University is
recognized as Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (SIRO) by
Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
